label: lifecycle-ready
title: Logical eligibility and physical presence
body: Three submissions cover two tenant/owner identities. A physical index entry, a logical include decision, live submission status and completed processing remain separate fields.

label: index-writing
title: Index write in flight
body: Settle or rebuild owns a write. A rebuild commits its tenant fence before the write; the modeled row locks delay a concurrent withdrawal until completion or the dispatch deadline.

label: index-cleanup
title: Index or payload cleanup pending
body: Invalidation and payload deletion are asynchronous. An index outage leaves a pending retry. A call returning after the fence can recreate an entry and reopen pending or completed removal.

label: withdrawal-recorded
title: Withdrawal recorded
body: An authorized source-session withdrawal marks the session and its mapped submissions, excludes unfinished index work, queues cleanup and invalidates exports. Completed deliveries remain part of recorded distribution reach.

label: retention
title: Expiry, hold and purge
body: Database-clock expiry removes live eligibility independently of the maintenance status. Legal hold blocks retention expiry marking and purge; queued propagation is represented separately.

label: export-ready
title: Export snapshot created
body: A ready snapshot pins selected source identities and requester/tenant metadata. Creation is separate from completion and does not establish a delivered export.

label: export-complete
title: Export manifest committed
body: Completion rechecks source liveness and allowed use while creating the manifest. A later withdrawal can invalidate this snapshot; the historical delivery bit remains set.

label: access-refused
title: Request or completion refused
body: Owner/tenant mismatch is not found. Missing authorization, invalidated sources, conflicting export metadata or an unavailable rebuild fence prevent the affected operation.
